output_shape:
When any tool output exceeds threshold, the raw output is replaced with a **CCR Marker Block**:
1. Content preview lines (first 3-5 lines of original, type-dependent)
2. Structure summary: `[code_rust: lang=rs;fns=main,run_single;structs=AppState;ln=414]`
3. CCR marker: `<<<CCR:HASH|TYPE|SIZE|MODE|preview=PREVIEW|key=val|...>>>`

For cache mode: `<<<CCR:hash|type|size>>>\n{first 512 bytes of content}`
For token mode: `<<<CCR:hash|type|size|metadata_flat>>>`
examples:
error[E0308]: mismatched types
[error: trace=src/proxy.rs:505:18;msg=E0308: mismatched types;N_errors=1]
<<<CCR:def789|error|892|token|preview=error[E0308]...|trace=src/proxy.rs:505:18|msg=E0308>>>

diff --git a/src/main.rs b/src/main.rs
--- a/src/main.rs
+++ b/src/main.rs
[diff:1f +12/-3 42L src/main.rs]
<<<CCR:f1e2d3c4|diff|4521|token|files=1|+=12|-=3|ln=42>>>
classification_type: CCR marker (detected by regex: <<<CCR:...>>> or [CCR:...] or ⫷CCR:...⫸). Sub-classified into: code_rust, code_python, code_go, code_js, code, error, diff, git, json, tool_output, build_output, log, linter, terminal, text, search_results, search_files, process_output, tabular, commit
key_extraction_fields: structured metadata (lang, fns, structs, classes, trace, msg, ln, keys, files, entries, adds, dels, exit, errors, warnings)
compression_benefit: this IS the compressed form - token savings: 40-373× depending on original size

output_shape: When classifier determines content has nothing worth retrieving (clean build: 0E 0W, exit=0 terminal, 0-match search), the raw output is replaced with **only the preview** - no CCR marker. The LLM sees just: `[build_output:0E 0W 142L]` or `[terminal:cargo build exit=0]`. Content IS stored in CCR for search/history.
classification_type: build_output (0E 0W), terminal (exit=0), search_files/search_results (0 matches) - clean/inert outputs
compression_benefit: maximum - preview IS the complete story; no CCR marker baits unnecessary retrieval
